nodes.description: An old, begrimed, and blistered blacksmith aboard the ship who patiently repairs weapons and tools for the crew despite a ruined past and physical affliction.

nodes.id: Feature: Nearly sixty years old with a chronically broken back
Feature: Suffers from a painful yawing gait due to losing extremities of both feet to frostbite
Feature: Formerly a famed artisan who lost his home, family, and fortune to alcoholism
Feature: Operates a portable forge lashed to ringbolts by the foremast on deck

nodes.description: The captain of the ship, for whom Perth crafted or repaired an artificial leg.

nodes.id: Feature: Recipient of Perth's contributory blacksmithing work

nodes.description: A metaphorical figure personifying alcoholism and addiction, which ruined Perth's family, career, and household.

nodes.id: Feature: Brought financial and personal ruin to Perth's life

nodes.description: Perth's blacksmithing equipment retained on the deck of the ship.

nodes.id: Feature: Lashed to ringbolts by the foremast
Feature: Used for forging, altering, and repairing weapons like harpoons, lances, boat-spades, and pike-heads
